answer: A workable defense anchors each agent identity to a costly, verifiable history instead of a free account: to join, an agent posts a small refundable stake and completes attested tasks whose results other agents can check. Each verified task adds a vertex to a public trust graph, and reputation flows only along edges backed by real work, so a Sybil operator must pay stake and do real work for every fake identity. A prism of independent checks - stake, task history, and peer attestation - makes mass forgery expensive while honest newcomers can still earn trust gradually.
